comment: D-REL-14: scripts/split-service.py --check's own cases, which --check runs after the tree (its self-test) and
tests/test_split_service.py runs one by one. `service` is a Service.qml text, `files` the code-behinds there by
name, `present` every script (*.js, *.mjs) beside it (default: the names in `files` that are scripts,
which the judge reads only as names unless Service.qml declares them).
`expect.refusal` is the kind of the first problem; `expect.counts`, for a clean service, the counts it must
report (a judge that stopped reading reads fewer). Generated with every newline written by code point.

cases.name: the layout as the readers read it, judged clean: one code-behind, its two forwarders, a root function, the root's own members, a change signal, and members of Item and QObject
a one-file service, as every tree has been until the first move: nothing to judge but the root's own members
the readers' refusal is --check's: a code-behind statement outside every function
the readers' refusal is --check's: a forwarder with its arguments swapped

files.Service-two.js:
// two

  function pair(a, b) { return a - b }

cases.name: the readers' refusal is --check's: a code-behind function no forwarder names
the readers' refusal is --check's: a declared code-behind that is not there
the readers' refusal is --check's: a script that is not a code-behind's name
one name in two code-behinds is two forwarders of one name on the root: refused
a code-behind beside Service.qml that it does not import is refused: nothing loads it, and no reader sees it
a code-behind calling another function through its qualifier, past the root, is refused
a root function calling a code-behind's qualifier outside its forwarder is refused
`this` in a code-behind is refused: the forwarder calls the function on the code-behind
`arguments` in a code-behind is refused: the forwarder passes only the names it lists
a code-behind calling one of its own functions unqualified is refused: say root.F
a ternary's branch naming one of its own functions is a reference, and refused
an object literal's key that spells one of its own functions names nothing, and reads
root.N for no member of the root, in a code-behind, is refused
root.N for no member of the root, in Service.qml's own code, is refused
an id is no member of the root: root.tick reads undefined, and is refused
root?.N and root["N"] are judged as root.N is
root["N"] for a member reads
root indexed by an expression is refused: no reading of the source can judge it
a property alias and a declared signal are members, and so are their change signal and the signal
the tokenizer losing its place in a code-behind is refused, never read past: a newline in a quoted string, which the readers' brace matcher crosses
a script that is no code-behind, beside Service.qml and imported in a spelling the readers do not see (a comment before `import`), is refused: QML loads it all the same
an ES module beside Service.qml that is not the model's is refused as undeclared
a Model.js beside a Service.qml that imports Model.mjs is refused as undeclared: only a tree from before D-REL-5 imports it
the model's own Model.mjs beside Service.qml is no undeclared script, and the layout reads clean
a function header at the root's indent inside another code-behind function, forwarded, is refused: the engine nests it, so its forwarder finds nothing, and the view holds it twice
root?.["N"] is judged as root.N is, and refused for no member
root?.["N"] for a member reads
root?.[expression] is refused as unjudged, as root[expression] is
